The weighted cloud reliability calculator passed all tests with a perfect reward score, confirming the core logic for risk assessment is functional.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.77 with zero exceptions across all trials. Pytest 8.4.1 successfully executed test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite in 0.91 seconds. While the logic is sound, the discrepancy between the verifier and judge rewards suggests potential for optimization in code style or edge-case handling.
